local dynamo={
	getSpellpower = function(self, t)
		local p = self:getSteam() / 100 -- Not using max_steam to be able to go over 100% bonus
		return p * 80 - 20
	end,
	callbackOnTalentPost = function(self, t, ab)
		if ab.is_spell and ab.mana and not ab.steam and ab.mode == "activated" then
			local m = util.getval(ab.mana, self, ab)
			if tonumber(m) then self:incSteam(m / 10 * (self:attr("arcane_dynamo") or 1)) end
		end
	end,
}
local moss={
	callbackOnMove = function(self, eff, moved, force, ox, oy)
		if not moved or force or (ox == self.x and oy == self.y) then return end
		self:callTalent(self.T_TINKER_MOSS_TREAD, nil, self.x, self.y, eff.dam)
	end,
}
local bloodstream={
	getDamageInc = function(self, t) return self:combatTalentSteamDamage(t, 50, 250) end,
	getDuration = function(self, t) return math.floor(self:combatTalentLimit(t, 4, 1, 2)) end,
	getDamage = function(self, t) return self:combatTalentSteamDamage(t, 50, 230) end,
	action = function(self, t)
		local weapon = self:hasWeaponType("steamsaw")
		if not weapon then return nil end
		local tg = {type="hit", range=self:getTalentRange(t)}
		local x, y, target = self:getTarget(tg)
		if not x or not y or not target then return nil end
		if core.fov.distance(self.x, self.y, x, y) > 1 then return nil end
		local was_cut = target:hasEffect(target.EFF_CUT)

		local hit = self:attackTarget(target, nil, self:combatTalentWeaponDamage(t, 0.3, 1.1), true)

		local cut = target:hasEffect(target.EFF_CUT)
		if hit and was_cut and cut and not cut.bloodstreamed then
			cut.bloodstreamed = true
			cut.dur = cut.dur + t.getDuration(self, t)
			cut.power = cut.power * t.getDamage(self, t) / 100

			local tg = {type="cone", range=0, talent=t, radius=4, cone_angle = 25}
			self:project(tg, target.x, target.y, DamageType.PHYSICAL, self:steamCrit(t.getDamage(self, t)))
			game.level.map:particleEmitter(self.x, self.y, tg.radius, "breath_blood", {radius=tg.radius, tx=target.x-self.x, ty=target.y-self.y, spread=20})
		end

		return true
	end,
}
local vortex={
	radius = function(self, t) if self:hasEffect(self.EFF_UPGRADE) then local eff = self:hasEffect(self.EFF_UPGRADE) return 3 + eff.range/2 else return 3 end end,
}
local guardian={
	callbackOnHit = function(self, t, cb, src)
		local eff = self:hasEffect(self.EFF_GUARDIAN_SHIELD)
		local effsrc = eff.src
		if effsrc == self then return nil end
		local split = cb.value * eff.power/100
		
			game:delayedLogDamage(src, effsrc, split, ("#STEEL_BLUE#(%d shared)#LAST#"):tformat(split), nil)
			cb.value = cb.value - split
			effsrc:takeHit(split, src)
		return cb.value
	end,
}

util={getval=function(x,...)if type(x)=="function" then return x(...)end return x end}
local generated=0;local caster={steam=0,rate=3,getSteam=function(s)return s.steam end,attr=function(s)return s.rate end,incSteam=function(s,n)generated=generated+n end}
local n=0
for _,steam in ipairs({0,10,24,25,26,100,150})do caster.steam=steam;assert(math.abs(dynamo.getSpellpower(caster,{})-(steam*.8-20))<1e-9);n=n+1 end
local cases={
 {ab={is_spell=true,mana=20,mode='activated'},expect=6},
 {ab={is_spell=true,mana=function()return 30 end,mode='activated'},expect=9},
 {ab={is_spell=true,mana=0,mode='activated'},expect=0},
 {ab={is_spell=true,mana=20,steam=0,mode='activated'},expect=0},
 {ab={is_spell=true,mana=20,mode='sustained'},expect=0},
 {ab={is_spell=false,mana=20,mode='activated'},expect=0},
 {ab={is_spell=true,mode='activated'},expect=0}}
for _,c in ipairs(cases)do generated=0;dynamo.callbackOnTalentPost(caster,{},c.ab);assert(generated==c.expect);n=n+1 end
-- Declared cost is consumed even if a separate hypothetical actual cost is zero.
caster.actual_mana_paid=0;generated=0;dynamo.callbackOnTalentPost(caster,{}, {is_spell=true,mana=20,mode='activated'});assert(generated==6)
local placed=0;local walker={x=1,y=2,T_TINKER_MOSS_TREAD=1,callTalent=function()placed=placed+1 end}
for _,c in ipairs({{true,false,0,2,1},{false,false,0,2,0},{true,true,0,2,0},{true,false,1,2,0}})do placed=0;moss.callbackOnMove(walker,{dam=5},c[1],c[2],c[3],c[4]);assert(placed==c[5]);n=n+1 end
local turret={EFF_UPGRADE=1,eff=nil,hasEffect=function(s)return s.eff end}
assert(vortex.radius(turret,{})==3)
for _,range in ipairs({2,3,4,6})do turret.eff={range=range};assert(vortex.radius(turret,{})==3+range/2);n=n+1 end
core={fov={distance=function()return 1 end}};DamageType={PHYSICAL=1};game={level={map={particleEmitter=function()end}},delayedLogDamage=function()end};string.tformat=string.format
local cut={dur=3,power=10};local victim={x=1,y=0,EFF_CUT=1,hasEffect=function()return cut end}
local hit=true;local projections=0
local attacker={x=0,y=0,hasWeaponType=function()return {}end,getTalentRange=function()return 1 end,getTarget=function()return 1,0,victim end,attackTarget=function()return hit end,combatTalentWeaponDamage=function()return .8 end,combatTalentSteamDamage=function(s,t,lo,hi)assert(lo==50);return hi==230 and 80 or 120 end,combatTalentLimit=function()return 2 end,steamCrit=function(s,x)return x end,project=function(s,tg,x,y,dt,damage)assert(damage==80);projections=projections+1 end}
assert(bloodstream.getDamageInc(attacker,bloodstream)==120 and bloodstream.getDamage(attacker,bloodstream)==80)
bloodstream.action(attacker,bloodstream);assert(cut.dur==5 and cut.power==8 and cut.bloodstreamed and projections==1)
bloodstream.action(attacker,bloodstream);assert(cut.dur==5 and cut.power==8 and projections==1)
cut={dur=3,power=10};hit=false;bloodstream.action(attacker,bloodstream);assert(cut.dur==3 and cut.power==10 and not cut.bloodstreamed)
local split=0;local guard={guardian_turret=true,takeHit=function(s,x)split=split+x end}
local guarded={guardian_turret=true,EFF_GUARDIAN_SHIELD=1,hasEffect=function()return {src=guard,power=30}end}
local cb={value=100};assert(guardian.callbackOnHit(guarded,nil,cb,{})==70 and cb.value==70 and split==30)
guard.EFF_GUARDIAN_SHIELD=1;guard.hasEffect=function()return {src=guard,power=30}end;cb={value=100};assert(guardian.callbackOnHit(guard,nil,cb,{})==nil and cb.value==100 and split==30)
print('PASS: Dynamo 7 steam boundaries + 7 spell/cost cases; declared-vs-paid cost; Moss 4 move/force cases; Vortex base+4 upgrade radii; Bloodstream actual factor not displayed increase, one-use and hit guards; Guardian other-guardian transfer/self exclusion')
